notes: Background music actually plays now (was silent): the music protocol serves CORS headers, the audio element fetches in CORS mode and the CSP allows the reimagined-music:// scheme as a media source. Music volume is now fully independent from the UI sound volume, with a live slider in the title-bar mini player (next to the logo) and in Settings → Audio. Turning UI sounds off no longer stops your music. Import is easier too: drag & drop mp3/flac/ogg straight onto the music player, or open the library folder with the new Folder button.
